## A CCDM pptx Theme for Quarto

This Quarto extension allows you to create your slides using a theme that follows CCDM typography and colour styles and provides the official CCDM logo and cover image for the title slide.

## Bullet point

- Point 1
- Point 2

## Tables

### Example

```{r}
#| label: tab
#| message: false
#| echo: false

library(dplyr)
library(flextable)

# set flextable theme
flex_tab <- flextable(
  head(airquality) |>
    mutate(`Month Name` = "May")
) |>
  autofit()
flex_tab
```
